AdrenalineDart.name: adrenaline dart
AdrenalineDart.desc: These darts are tipped with a swiftthistle-based compound which will boost the movement and attack speed of allies, or briefly lower the movement speed of enemies. The dart itself is still harmful to enemies, but will not harm allies.

Affection.name: %s of affection
Affection.desc: This powerful glyph manipulates the mind of attackers, charming them temporarily.

AlchemistsToolkit.name: alchemist's toolkit
AlchemistsToolkit.desc: This toolkit contains a number of reagents and herbs along with a small mixing vial, allowing for alchemy on-the-go. The vial contains what looks like alchemical energy crystals in liquid form.

Alchemize.name: alchemize
Alchemize.desc:
This spell contains transmutative powers similar to those found in an alchemy pot. Each cast allows the user to turn an item (or stack of items) into gold or alchemical energy. Turning potions or scrolls into energy will even identify them!

A few Alchemize uses are sold from shops, but many more can be made using alchemy by combining a seed, runestone, and a little alchemical energy.

AlchemyPage.name: torn alchemy book page
AlchemyPage.desc:
A torn page from a guidebook on alchemy.

Most of the text is too small to read at a distance, but you can make out the title of the page:

_"%s"_

Amulet.name: amulet of yendor
Amulet.desc: The Amulet of Yendor is the most powerful artifact known to human or dwarf kind. Its shimmering crystals contain incredible and wondrous power.

Ankh.name: ankh
Ankh.desc: This ancient symbol of immortality grants the ability to return to life after death. Most items will be dropped where you died, but can be reclaimed if you return to it. Using a full waterskin, the ankh can be blessed with extra strength.

Annoying.name: annoying %s
Annoying.desc: Annoying weapons are capable of speech, but they're a bit too energetic. They will often draw attention to you without meaning to.

AntiEntropy.name: %s of anti-entropy
AntiEntropy.desc: The Anti-entropy curse works against the forces of the universe, pulling energy into the wearer and away from their surroundings. This briefly sets the wearer on fire, but freezes everything around them!

AntiMagic.name: %s of anti-magic
AntiMagic.desc: This powerful glyph allows armor to defend its wearer against magical attacks as well as physical ones. This magical defence is not affected by the armor's tier.

AquaBrew.name: aqua brew
AquaBrew.desc: When shattered, this brew will release a burst of pressurized water at its location. It's only forceful enough to damage fiery enemies, but it also spreads water to nearby terrain, disables traps, douses fires, and knocks back characters near the burst.

ArcaneBomb.name: arcane bomb
ArcaneBomb.desc: This bomb has been imbued with arcane properties. It will explode into a powerful blast similar to Goo's pumped up attack, dealing _%1$d-%2$d magical damage_ to anything within 2 tiles.

ArcaneResin.name: arcane resin
ArcaneResin.desc:
This fine powder shimmers between shades of purple and white. It can act as an amplifier to magical energies, increasing the level of wands when it is applied to them!

Upgrading a wand costs 1, 2, or 3 resin depending on the wand's initial level. Resin can upgrade wands to a maximum of +3.

Resin upgrades are _overridden by other upgrade sources_ however (such as scrolls of upgrade), and do not apply when imbuing a wand into the Mage's staff.

AssassinsBlade.name: assassin's blade
AssassinsBlade.desc: A small wavy blade made of obsidian, difficult to use despite being lightweight, but deadly if it finds the right mark.

BattleAxe.name: battle axe
BattleAxe.desc: The enormous steel head of this battle axe puts considerable heft behind each wide stroke.

BeaconOfReturning.name: beacon of returning
BeaconOfReturning.desc: This intricate spell grants the user the ability to return to a set location, regardless of distance. The spell will only be consumed by returning, it can be set as many times as you like, but it will only remember the most recent location it was set to.

Berry.name: dungeon berry
Berry.desc: This small berry was found by the Huntress among the dungeon's vegetation. It can be eaten quickly, restores a small amount of satiety, and might contain a usable seed!

Blandfruit.name: blandfruit
Blandfruit.desc: So dry and insubstantial, perhaps stewing it with another ingredient would improve it.

Blazing.name: blazing %s
Blazing.desc: This enchantment causes flames to spit forth from a weapon, igniting enemies and dealing bonus damage to enemies that are already aflame.

BlindingDart.name: blinding dart
BlindingDart.desc: These darts are tipped with a blindweed-based compound which will blind their target for a short time. They do not disorient however, so an enemy will still know where they last saw you.

BlizzardBrew.name: blizzard brew
BlizzardBrew.desc: When shattered, this brew will unleash a swirling blizzard which quickly spreads like a gas.

Blocking.name: blocking %s
Blocking.desc: Blocking weapons have a chance to briefly shield you after attacking with them.

Blooming.name: blooming %s
Blooming.desc: Blooming weapons contain magic which will cause vegetation to sprout on or around those struck by them.

Bolas.name: bolas
Bolas.desc: These unusual ranged weapons aren't very damaging, but do an excellent job of slowing their target.

Bomb.name: bomb
Bomb.desc: A fairly hefty black powder bomb. An explosion from this bomb deals _%1$d-%2$d damage_ to anything adjacent to it, and will destroy some adjacent terrain or items.

BowFragment.name: bow fragment
BowFragment.desc: This broken fragment of wood was once part of a lost Huntress' spirit bow. You can still feel a little nature energy left in the fragment, you can use the fragment to grow some high grass around you. Doing this will destroy the fragment however.

Brimstone.name: %s of brimstone
Brimstone.desc: This glyph shields the wearer and their belongings from fire, completely nullifying its damage and negative effects.

BrokenHilt.name: broken hilt
BrokenHilt.desc: This broken hilt looks like it came from a defeated Duelist's weapon. You can still feel a little martial power left in the hilt, you can use it to get a little bonus damage on your next two melee hits. Doing this will destroy the hilt however.

BrokenSeal.name: broken seal
BrokenSeal.desc:
A wax seal, affixed to armor as a symbol of valor. It has a faded rune of protection engraved in the center, and is cracked in half across the middle.

A memento from his home, the seal helps the warrior persevere. While wearing the seal the warrior will instantly gain shielding when he is about to be damaged to half health or lower.

The seal can be _affixed to armor,_ and moved between armors. It can carry a single upgrade with it, so long as that upgrade was applied to the armor while the seal was attached to it.

BrokenStaff.name: broken staff
BrokenStaff.desc: This Mage's staff has been broken in half after its owner met their demise. You can still feel some magical energy left in the staff, you can use it to give your wands a little charge boost. Doing this will destroy the staff however.

Bulk.name: %s of bulk
Bulk.desc: Armor of bulk looks larger and more imposing, but doesn't actually have enhanced defense. Even worse, the added size makes moving into doorways very difficult.

Camouflage.name: %s of camouflage
Camouflage.desc: This glyph allows the wearer to blend into tall grass, granting them temporary invisibility.

CapeOfThorns.name: cape of thorns
CapeOfThorns.desc: These collapsed sheets of metal from the DM-300 have formed together into a rigid cape. It seems to store a deep energy, perhaps it has some of the DM-300's power?

CausticBrew.name: caustic brew
CausticBrew.desc: This brew will spread corrosive ooze in a wide area around the location it shatters in. Anything caught by the ooze will slowly melt if it can't wash it off in water.

CeremonialCandle.name: ceremonial candle
CeremonialCandle.desc:
A set of candles, melted down and fused together through use.

Alone they are worthless, but used with other candles in a pattern, they can focus the energy for a summoning ritual.

ChaliceOfBlood.name: chalice of blood
ChaliceOfBlood.desc: This shining silver chalice is oddly adorned with sharp gems at the rim.

ChaoticCenser.name: chaotic censer
ChaoticCenser.desc: After some time in the alchemy pot this incense-burning censer appears to be producing smoke all on its own! These gasses build up and will spew forth from the censer toward enemies at semi-random intervals. It seems capable of producing all sorts of gasses, but you'll get a moment of warning just before the censer activates.

ChargrilledMeat.name: chargrilled meat
ChargrilledMeat.desc: It looks like a decent steak.

Chilling.name: chilling %s
Chilling.desc: Enemies struck with this enchantment are chilled, slowing their movement and attacks.

ChillingDart.name: chilling dart
ChillingDart.desc: These darts are tipped with an icecap-based compound which will significantly chill their target.

CleansingDart.name: cleansing dart
CleansingDart.desc: These darts are tipped with a mageroyal-based compound which will temporarily make allies immune to all negative effects, or will cleanse positive effects from enemies. Enemies may even briefly forget that they are attacking or fleeing from you. The dart itself is still harmful to enemies, but will not harm allies.

ClericArmor.name: hero's vestments
ClericArmor.desc: While wearing this mixture of cloth and plate, the Cleric can perform a special ability.

CloakOfShadows.name: cloak of shadows
CloakOfShadows.desc:
A priceless magical cloak, stolen from the royal armory many years ago by the Rogue. When worn, it can be used to turn completely invisible for a short time.

The more the cloak is used, the stronger it will become, allowing the Rogue to become invisible more frequently and for longer durations.

CloakScrap.name: scrap of fabric
CloakScrap.desc: This scrap of translucent fabric looks like it came from a late Rogue's cloak of shadows. You can still feel a little mystical energy left in it, you can use it to give your artifacts a little charge boost. Doing this will destroy the fabric however.

ClothArmor.name: cloth armor
ClothArmor.desc: This lightweight armor offers basic protection.

CorpseDust.name: corpse dust
CorpseDust.desc:
The ball of corpse dust doesn't differ outwardly from a regular dust ball. But you can feel a malevolent energy lurking within it.

Getting rid of it as soon as possible would be a good idea.

Corrosion.name: %s of corrosion
Corrosion.desc: Armor of corrosion is capable of bursting with corrosive fluid, coating everything in the area with sticky acidic ooze.

Corrupting.name: corrupting %s
Corrupting.desc: This powerful enchantment possesses the ability to turn enemies to your will. When an enemy is killed with this weapon, there is a chance they will become corrupted instead of dying.

CrackedSpyglass.name: cracked spyglass
CrackedSpyglass.desc: This handheld telescope would be a demonstration of great and precise workmanship, if it weren't for the crack along its front lens. The spyglass seems to be helping you by revealing new items in the dungeon, but due to its flaw the revealed items are quite hard to see!

Crossbow.name: crossbow
Crossbow.desc: A fairly intricate weapon which shoots bolts at exceptional speeds. While it isn't designed for it, this crossbow's heft and sturdy construction make it a decent melee weapon as well.

Crystal.name: crystal %s
Crystal.desc: This powerful enchantment deals extra magic damage and enhances a weapon's value. However, the enchanted weapon can shatter if the crystals aren't repaired, or given time to self-repair.

CrystalKey.name: Crystal key
CrystalKey.desc: The cut surfaces of this crystalline key shimmer in the darkness. Perhaps it will open something made of crystal?

Cudgel.name: cudgel
Cudgel.desc: A small brass mace, made more as a self-defense tool for nobles than as an adventuring weapon.

CurseInfusion.name: curse infusion
CurseInfusion.desc:
This spell infuses a piece of equipment with the same powerful malignant magic present within DM-300. The item it is used on will immediately be cursed, and any enchantment or glyph it may have had will be overridden.

In the case of weapons, armor, and wands, the item will gain upgrades in addition to being cursed. Curse infusion upgrades do not stack, and the upgrades are lost if the item becomes uncursed.

Multiple curse infusions can also be used to change the curse on a weapon or armor.

Dagger.name: dagger
Dagger.desc: A simple iron dagger with a worn wooden handle.

DarkGold.name: dark gold ore
DarkGold.desc: This metal is called dark not because of its color (it doesn't differ from the normal gold), but because it melts under the daylight, making it useless on the surface.

Dart.name: dart
Dart.desc: These simple shafts of spike-tipped wood are weighted to fly true and sting their prey with a flick of the wrist. They can be tipped with seeds to gain bonus effects when thrown.

Dazzling.name: dazzling %s
Dazzling.desc: Dazzling weapons will sometimes flash with dazzling light, blinding everything that can see them.

Dewdrop.name: dewdrop
Dewdrop.desc:
A crystal clear dewdrop.

Due to the magic of this place, pure water has minor restorative properties.

DimensionalSundial.name: dimensional sundial
DimensionalSundial.desc: This small handheld sundial is somehow able to cast a shadow in the depths of the dungeon, even if you aren't holding it upright. Even more strangely, the shadow's position seems to have no relation to the sun in this world. When no shadow is cast, the sundial seems to attract danger.

Dirk.name: dirk
Dirk.desc: A longer thrusting dagger, gives a bit more steel to plunge into foes.

Displacement.name: %s of displacement
Displacement.desc: The curse of displacement attempts to move the wearer to safety when they are attacked. It is a bit too effective however, randomly teleporting the user around the level.

Displacing.name: displacing %s
Displacing.desc: Displacing weapons are infused with chaotic teleportation magic, possessing the ability to warp enemies around the floor randomly.

DisplacingDart.name: displacing dart
DisplacingDart.desc: These darts are tipped with a fadeleaf-based compound which will teleport their target a short distance away.

DocumentPage.name: torn page
DocumentPage.desc: A lone page, probably torn from a book of some sort. You'll need to pick it up to read it.

DriedRose.name: dried rose
DriedRose.desc: Is this the rose that the ghost mentioned before disappearing? It seems to hold some spiritual power, perhaps it can be used to channel the energy of that lost warrior.

DuelistArmor.name: hero's breastplate
DuelistArmor.desc: While wearing this plate armor and cape, the Duelist can perform a special ability.

DwarfToken.name: dwarf token
DwarfToken.desc: A strange shaped piece of metal that was being held by a denizen of the dwarven vault. Perhaps it is part of the magic that was binding it to the vault? Best to hold onto it, it might have some use.

Elastic.name: elastic %s
Elastic.desc: Elastic weapons have a chance to send enemies flying back short distances.

Eldritch.name: eldritch %s
Eldritch.desc: Eldritch weapons strike fear into nearby enemies that witness their strikes, causing them to flee from the attacker.

ElixirOfAquaticRejuvenation.name: elixir of aquatic rejuvenation
ElixirOfAquaticRejuvenation.desc: This elixir contains the remains of Goo enhanced with a healing potion. While it will not provide immediate healing, it will steadily restore a greater amount of health while you are standing in water.

ElixirOfArcaneArmor.name: elixir of arcane armor
ElixirOfArcaneArmor.desc: This elixir will grant the drinker a long lasting resistance to magical damage.

ElixirOfDragonsBlood.name: elixir of dragon's blood
ElixirOfDragonsBlood.desc: When consumed, this elixir will send fiery power coursing through the drinker's veins. This effect will make the drinker immune to fire, and allow them to set enemies aflame with physical attacks.

ElixirOfFeatherFall.name: elixir of feather fall
ElixirOfFeatherFall.desc: This elixir offers a weaker but more controlled levitation effect, allowing the drinker to fall great distances without harm for a little while.

ElixirOfHoneyedHealing.name: elixir of honeyed healing
ElixirOfHoneyedHealing.desc:
This elixir combines healing with the sweetness of honey. When drank, it will apply the same effect as a potion of healing and satisfy a small amount of hunger, but it can also be thrown to heal an ally.

Creatures with an affinity for honey might be pacified if this item is used on them.

ElixirOfIcyTouch.name: elixir of icy touch
ElixirOfIcyTouch.desc: When consumed, this elixir will allow the drinker to sap the heat from enemies they attack. This effect will make the drinker immune to the cold, and allow them to chill enemies with physical attacks.

ElixirOfMight.name: elixir of might
ElixirOfMight.desc: This powerful liquid will course through your muscles, permanently increasing your strength by one point and temporarily increasing maximum health by %d points. The health boost scales with your maximum health, but will slowly wear off as you gain levels.

ElixirOfToxicEssence.name: elixir of toxic essence
ElixirOfToxicEssence.desc: When consumed, this elixir will imbue the drinker with toxic energy. The drinker will continuously spread toxic gas as they move, and will be immune to toxic gas and poison for slightly longer than the duration of the effect.

Embers.name: elemental embers
Embers.desc: Special embers which can only be harvested from young fire elementals. They radiate thermal energy.

EnergyCrystal.name: energy crystal
EnergyCrystal.desc:
A collection of small magical crystals, filled with alchemical energy.

These crystals are the most common ingredient in alchemy recipes and can be produced at an alchemy pot by scrapping consumable items.

Entanglement.name: %s of entanglement
Entanglement.desc: This glyph grows earthen armor around the wearer to absorb damage, but this armor will break if the wearer moves.

EscapeCrystal.name: escape crystal
EscapeCrystal.desc: A thin magical spell crystal that seems to contain teleportation magic. You can use the crystal at any time to leave the dwarven vault, but if you leave early you won't get the full reward!

EtherealChains.name: ethereal chains
EtherealChains.desc: These large yet lightweight chains glow with spiritual energy. They can be used to pull you towards terrain, or pull enemies toward you. The ethereal nature of the chains even allows them to extend through walls!

ExoticCrystals.name: exotic crystals
ExoticCrystals.desc: These small pink crystals have the same shape as crystals of alchemical energy. While they can't be used for energy directly, they seem to be somehow influencing the potions and scrolls you find.

Explosive.name: explosive %s
Explosive.desc: Explosive weapons steadily build up power and explode, damaging anything nearby.

EyeOfNewt.name: eye of newt
EyeOfNewt.desc: This golden and black newt's eye is a common ingredient, now enhanced into a trinket. The eye seems to be reducing your vision in exchange for letting you see things in other ways.

FerretTuft.name: ferret tuft
FerretTuft.desc: A tuft of silky white ferret fur, held together by a Lime green ribbon tied into a bow. Ferrets are known for their agility, mischievousness, and lack of integrity. Some of that power seems to radiate from the trinket, enhancing the evasion of anything nearby.

Firebomb.name: firebomb
Firebomb.desc: This bomb has been modified to explode in a larger area, dealing _%1$d-%2$d damage_ and spreading sustained flame within 2 tiles.

FishingSpear.name: fishing spear
FishingSpear.desc: Tiny throwing spears that work well as an improvised weapon despite being designed for fishing.

Flail.name: flail
Flail.desc: A spiked ball attached to a handle by a length of chain. Very unwieldy, but devastating if it lands a solid hit.

FlashBangBomb.name: flashbang
FlashBangBomb.desc: This customized bomb will erupt into a blast of light, sound, and electricity when it explodes. Anything within 2 tiles will take _%1$d-%2$d damage_ from the explosion, an additional 25%% damage from the electricity, and be stunned for 10 turns.

Flow.name: %s of flow
Flow.desc: This glyph manipulates the flow of water around the wearer, making them much faster when moving through it.

Food.name: ration of food
Food.desc: Nothing fancy here: dried meat, some biscuits - things like that.

ForceCube.name: force cube
ForceCube.desc: These oddly-shaped magical cubes are small enough to hold in your hand, but are incredibly heavy.

Friendly.name: friendly %s
Friendly.desc: Friendly weapons are best suited for pacifists, occasionally triggering magic that makes it impossible to fight.

FrostBomb.name: frost bomb
FrostBomb.desc: This bomb has been modified to explode in a larger area, dealing _%1$d-%2$d damage_ and spreading a sustained gust of freezing air within 2 tiles.

FrozenCarpaccio.name: frozen carpaccio
FrozenCarpaccio.desc: It's a piece of frozen raw meat. The only way to eat it is by cutting thin slices of it. And this way it's surprisingly good.

Gauntlet.name: stone gauntlet
Gauntlet.desc: This massive gauntlet is made of crimson fabric with heavy magical stone layered on top. The fabric tightens around you, making the thick stone plates almost like a second skin. Swinging such a heavy weapon requires strength, but adds tremendous force to your blows.

Glaive.name: glaive
Glaive.desc: A massive polearm consisting of a sword blade on the end of a pole.

Gloves.name: studded gloves
Gloves.desc: These studded gloves don't provide any real protection, but they act as a serviceable weapon while keeping the hands free.

Gold.name: gold
Gold.desc: A pile of gold coins. Collect gold coins to spend them later in a shop.

GoldenKey.name: golden key
GoldenKey.desc: The notches on this golden key are tiny and intricate. Perhaps it will open a locked chest?

GooBlob.name: blob of goo
GooBlob.desc:
A jiggly blob of goop, split off from Goo as it died. It's almost like a big ball of jelly, though you wouldn't dare eat it.

It does nothing on its own, but it might be useful when combined with certain potions, or a bomb. At the very least it should convert into a decent amount of energy.

Greataxe.name: greataxe
Greataxe.desc: Meant to be wielded over the shoulder, this titanic axe is as powerful as it is heavy.

Greatshield.name: greatshield
Greatshield.desc: More like a mobile wall than a shield, this gigantic mass of metal aids defense, but doesn't leave much room for attacking.

Greatsword.name: greatsword
Greatsword.desc: This towering blade inflicts heavy damage by investing its heft into every swing.

Grim.name: grim %s
Grim.desc: This powerful enchantment possesses the power to instantly execute an enemy. The effect is more likely to occur the weaker the enemy is.

GuidePage.name: torn guidebook page
GuidePage.desc:
A torn page from an adventuring guidebook.

Most of the text is too small to read at a distance, but you can make out the title of the page:

_"%s"_

Guidebook.name: tome of dungeon mastery
Guidebook.desc:
An adventurer's guidebook, left here by someone who decided adventuring wasn't for them! This particular book is magical, and can prompt adventurers to read a page at the right moment.

Despite that functionality, the book is most popular because of the big words "Don't Panic!" written in large friendly letters on the cover.

HandAxe.name: hand axe
HandAxe.desc: A light axe, most commonly used for felling trees. The wide blade works well against foes as well.

HealingDart.name: healing dart
HealingDart.desc: These darts are tipped with a sungrass-based compound which grants a burst of healing to their target. The dart itself is still harmful to enemies, but will not harm allies.

HeavyBoomerang.name: heavy boomerang
HeavyBoomerang.desc: This large boomerang is difficult to wield effectively, but will deal considerable damage.

HolyBomb.name: holy bomb
HolyBomb.desc: This bomb has been modified to flash holy light in a larger area when it explodes. Anything within 2 tiles will take _%1$d-%2$d damage_ from the explosion, and undead or demonic enemies will take an additional 50%% damage from the holy light.

HolyDart.name: holy dart
HolyDart.desc: These darts are tipped with a starflower-based compound which infuses holy energy into their target. Allies and regular enemies will become blessed, but undead or demonic enemies will take heavy damage. The dart itself is still harmful to enemies, but will not harm allies.

HolyTome.name: holy tome
HolyTome.desc:
A holy tome that acts as a focus for the Cleric's divine magic. Using the tome lets the Cleric cast a variety of magical spells.

The tome will steadily get more powerful as the Cleric uses it, giving the Cleric more maximum charges and slightly increasing the recharging speed.

Honeypot.name: honeypot
Honeypot.desc: This large honeypot is only really lined with honey, instead it houses a giant bee! These sorts of massive bees usually stay in their hives, perhaps the pot is some sort of specialized trapper's cage? The bee seems pretty content inside the pot with its honey, and buzzes at you warily when you look at it.

HornOfPlenty.name: horn of plenty
HornOfPlenty.desc: This horn can't be blown into, but instead seems to fill up with food as you adventure and gain experience. You can consume each charge individually as a snack, or eat until you're full.

HuntressArmor.name: hero's cloak
HuntressArmor.desc: While wearing this cloak, the Huntress can perform a special ability.

ImpStatue.name: obsidian statuette
ImpStatue.desc: A small jet-black statue carved out of obsidian. It resembles the Imp who sent you down here, it even has their glowing green eyes. There is an inscription on the base of the statue in a language you've never seen before.

IncendiaryDart.name: incendiary dart
IncendiaryDart.desc: These darts are tipped with a firebloom-based compound which will burst into brilliant flames on impact.

InfernalBrew.name: infernal brew
InfernalBrew.desc: When shattered, this brew will unleash a raging inferno which quickly spreads like a gas.

IronKey.name: iron key
IronKey.desc: The notches on this ancient iron key are well worn; its leather lanyard is battered by age. What door might it open?

Javelin.name: javelin
Javelin.desc: These larger throwing spears are weighted to keep the spike at their tip foremost as they sail through the air.

Katana.name: katana
Katana.desc: A slender sword with a large metal guard above the handle.

Kinetic.name: kinetic %s
Kinetic.desc: When an enemy is killed with a kinetic weapon, any excess force is stored in the weapon and will be applied to the next successful attack.

KingsCrown.name: Dwarf King's crown
KingsCrown.desc:
The crown of the last dwarven king, it glows with tremendous magical energy.

When worn, the crown's magic will flow into the armor you're currently wearing, transforming it into a _unique epic armor with special abilities._ The new armor will keep all the properties of the original armor.

Kunai.name: kunai
Kunai.desc: These small knives are very powerful in the hands of a skilled user.

LeatherArmor.name: leather armor
LeatherArmor.desc: Armor made from tanned monster hide. Not as light as cloth armor but provides better protection.

LiquidMetal.name: liquid metal
LiquidMetal.desc:
This magical liquid can fill into the cracks and tears on a thrown weapon, restoring it to perfect condition! If a set of weapons is missing a weapon but otherwise fully repaired, then liquid metal can even be used to replace a missing weapon from the set!

A tier 1 weapon requires 10 liquid metal to be fully repaired, a tier 5 weapon requires 30. Each upgrade also increases the amount of metal needed by 35%.

Liquid metal cannot be used to repair the tips on tipped darts.

LloydsBeacon.name: lloyd's beacon
LloydsBeacon.desc: Lloyd's beacon is an intricate magical device which grants the user control of teleportation magics. The beacon can be used to return to a set location, but can also expel bursts of random teleportation magic once it has charged from being equipped. This magic can be directed at a target or at the user themselves.

Longsword.name: longsword
Longsword.desc: This sword's long razor-sharp steel blade shines reassuringly, though its size does make it quite heavy.

LostBackpack.name: lost backpack
LostBackpack.desc: This is your lost inventory. Collect it to reclaim all the items you lost!

Lucky.name: lucky %s
Lucky.desc: Enemies which are killed by a lucky weapon have a chance to drop extra loot.

Mace.name: mace
Mace.desc: The large iron head of this weapon inflicts substantial damage.

MageArmor.name: hero's robe
MageArmor.desc: While wearing this gorgeous robe, the Mage can perform a special ability.

MagesStaff.name: mage's staff
MagesStaff.desc: Crafted by the Mage himself, this staff is a unique magical weapon which can be imbued with a wand.

MagicalHolster.name: magical holster
MagicalHolster.desc:
This slim holster is made from some exotic animal hide, and possesses powerful magic which lets it store a massive amount of ranged weapons.

You can simply reach into the bag and will always grab the item you were looking for.

Due to the holster's magic, wands will charge slightly faster and thrown weapons will last slightly longer inside of it.

MagicalInfusion.name: magical infusion
MagicalInfusion.desc:
This spell possesses the same magical power as a scroll of upgrade, but in a more stable form.

In addition to upgrading an item as normal it will never erase an enchantment, glyph, or curse.

MailArmor.name: mail armor
MailArmor.desc: Interlocking metal links make for a tough but flexible suit of armor.

MasterThievesArmband.name: master thieves' armband
MasterThievesArmband.desc: This purple velvet armband bears the mark of a master thief. This doesn't belong to you, but it probably didn't belong to its last user either.

MeatPie.name: meat pie
MeatPie.desc: A delicious pie filled with savoury meat. This will satiate you far more than any other meal.

Metabolism.name: %s of metabolism
Metabolism.desc: The metabolism curse directly converts satiety into health when the wearer is injured, providing a boost of healing, but quickly causing starvation.

MetalShard.name: cursed metal shard
MetalShard.desc:
A shard of rusted cursed metal, which broke off DM-300 as it was destroyed. You can feel an inactive malevolent magic within it.

It does nothing on its own, but it might be useful when combined with certain scrolls, or a bomb. At the very least it should convert into a decent amount of energy.

MimicTooth.name: mimic tooth
MimicTooth.desc: This large sharp tooth must have been pulled from a very unhappy mimic. It seems to be influencing the mimics of the dungeon, making them more frequent and dangerous.

MossyClump.name: mossy clump
MossyClump.desc: This clump of wet moss seems to hold onto its moisture no matter how hard you squeeze it. It seems to be magically tied to the dungeon itself, making grass and water more likely to appear.

Multiplicity.name: %s of multiplicity
Multiplicity.desc: Armor cursed with multiplicity contains dangerous duplication magic. It will sometimes create a mirror image of the wearer, but is equally likely to duplicate the attacker!

Noisemaker.name: noisemaker
Noisemaker.desc: This customized bomb will repeatedly make noise when its fuse runs out. When something touches the bomb, it will explode and deal _%1$d-%2$d damage_ to anything within 2 tiles!

Obfuscation.name: %s of obfuscation
Obfuscation.desc: This glyph obscures the wearer, making them more difficult to detect.

Overgrowth.name: %s of overgrowth
Overgrowth.desc: Armor of overgrowth is covered in various blooming plants. While this effect certainly looks interesting, it does nothing for defense, and these plants will randomly activate in combat!

ParalyticDart.name: paralytic dart
ParalyticDart.desc: These darts are tipped with an earthroot-based compound which will paralyze their target for a short time.

ParchmentScrap.name: parchment scrap
ParchmentScrap.desc: This little scrap of parchment looks like it came from a scroll. It has retained some of its magic, and it seems to be influencing weapons and armor found in the dungeon.

Pasty.name: pasty
Pasty.desc: An authentic Cornish pasty with a traditional filling of beef and potato. Delicious!

PetrifiedSeed.name: petrified seed
PetrifiedSeed.desc: This seed has been fossilised, either by slow geological processes or by magic. The seed seems to be magically influencing the flora of the dungeon, occasionally replacing plant seeds with runestones.

PhantomMeat.name: phantom meat
PhantomMeat.desc: A large glistening translucent steak, cut from a phantom piranha. This magical meat doesn't need to be cooked and grants a number of defensive benefits in addition to fully satiating you. When eaten it will grant invisibility, barkskin, some healing, and cures many harmful effects.

PhaseShift.name: phase shift
PhaseShift.desc: This chaotic spell will teleport any character it is aimed at to a random location on the current floor, and stun them for a significant amount of time. Powerful foes will be able to resist the stunning effect. This spell can be directed at a target or at the user themselves.

Pickaxe.name: pickaxe
Pickaxe.desc: This is a sturdy and heavy tool for breaking rocks. You don't need to equip the pickaxe to mine with it, but it can probably be equipped as a weapon in a pinch.

PlateArmor.name: plate armor
PlateArmor.desc: Enormous plates of metal are joined together into a suit that provides unmatched protection to any adventurer strong enough to bear its staggering weight.

PoisonDart.name: poison dart
PoisonDart.desc: These darts are tipped with a sorrowmoss-based compound which will poison their target.

Polarized.name: polarized %s
Polarized.desc: A polarized weapon is affected by magic that causes its attack to either deal 50% more damage, or no damage at all.

Potential.name: %s of potential
Potential.desc: This glyph builds energy when struck, granting charge to the wearer's wand when it activates.

PotionBandolier.name: potion bandolier
PotionBandolier.desc:
This thick bandolier fits around your chest like a sash, it has many insulated straps on it to hold potion vials, your waterskin, or liquid metal vials.

While inside the bandolier, your potions should be protected from the cold.

PotionOfCleansing.name: potion of cleansing
PotionOfCleansing.desc: This powerful reagent will render the drinker immune to all harmful status effects for a few turns when quaffed. It can be thrown at a target to cleanse them as well.

PotionOfCorrosiveGas.name: potion of corrosive gas
PotionOfCorrosiveGas.desc: Uncorking or shattering this pressurized glass will cause its contents to explode into a deadly cloud of corrosive rust-colored gas. The gas spreads more quickly than toxic gas and is more deadly, but also won't last as long.

PotionOfDivineInspiration.name: potion of divine inspiration
PotionOfDivineInspiration.desc:
The power of holy energy reduced to liquid form, this draught will imbue the drinker with divine power, granting them two bonus talent points in a tier of their choosing.

This potion can only be used once for each talent tier.

PotionOfDragonsBreath.name: potion of dragon's breath
PotionOfDragonsBreath.desc: This flask contains an unusual compound which bursts into flame shortly after mixing with saliva. Quickly spitting the liquid will allow the user to spew flame from their mouth!

PotionOfEarthenArmor.name: potion of earthen armor
PotionOfEarthenArmor.desc: Rather than paralyze, this liquid has a hardening effect on the skin which will turn it into temporary natural armor.

PotionOfExperience.name: potion of experience
PotionOfExperience.desc: The storied experiences of multitudes of battles reduced to liquid form, this draught will instantly raise your experience level.

PotionOfFrost.name: potion of frost
PotionOfFrost.desc: The chemical contained in this potion will evaporate into a freezing cloud upon exposure to open air.

PotionOfHaste.name: potion of haste
PotionOfHaste.desc: Drinking this oddly sweet liquid will imbue you with tremendous energy for a short time, allowing you to run at high speeds.

PotionOfHealing.name: potion of healing
PotionOfHealing.desc: This elixir will rapidly restore your health and instantly cure many ailments.

PotionOfInvisibility.name: potion of invisibility
PotionOfInvisibility.desc: Drinking this potion will render you temporarily invisible. While invisible, enemies will be unable to see you. Physical attacks and magical effects (such as scrolls and wands) will immediately cancel invisibility.

PotionOfLevitation.name: potion of levitation
PotionOfLevitation.desc: Drinking this curious liquid will cause you to hover in the air, able to drift effortlessly over traps and pits. Throwing this potion will create a cloud of unrefined gas, disorienting anything caught in it.

PotionOfLiquidFlame.name: potion of liquid flame
PotionOfLiquidFlame.desc: This flask contains an unstable compound which will burst violently into flame upon exposure to open air.

PotionOfMagicalSight.name: potion of magical sight
PotionOfMagicalSight.desc: After drinking this, your senses will be briefly heightened to incredible levels, allowing you to see through walls in a 12 tile radius!

PotionOfMastery.name: potion of mastery
PotionOfMastery.desc:
Rather than granting raw strength, this potion will instead attune the muscles of the user to a particular item. This will make that item easier to use, as if the drinker had practised with it and built muscle memory.

The chosen weapon or armor will require 2 less strength to use. This potion can only be used once on each item.

PotionOfMindVision.name: potion of mind vision
PotionOfMindVision.desc: After drinking this, your mind will become attuned to the psychic signature of distant creatures, enabling you to sense biological presences through walls. Also this potion will permit you to see through nearby walls and doors.

PotionOfParalyticGas.name: potion of paralytic gas
PotionOfParalyticGas.desc: Upon exposure to open air, the liquid in this flask will vaporize into a numbing yellow haze. Anyone who inhales the cloud will be paralyzed instantly, unable to move for some time after the cloud dissipates. This item can be thrown at distant enemies to catch them within the effect of the gas.

PotionOfPurity.name: potion of purity
PotionOfPurity.desc: This magical reagent will quickly neutralize all harmful area-bound effects in a large area. Drinking it will give you temporary immunity to such effects.

PotionOfShielding.name: potion of shielding
PotionOfShielding.desc: Rather than heal, this potion will instead project a durable shield around the user's body, blocking a considerable amount of damage.

PotionOfShroudingFog.name: potion of shrouding fog
PotionOfShroudingFog.desc: When exposed to air, the liquid in this flask will produce a thick smoky fog which quickly spreads and blocks the vision of your enemies.

PotionOfSnapFreeze.name: potion of snap freeze
PotionOfSnapFreeze.desc: The chemical contained in this potion will rapidly react with the air, instantly freezing and rooting all within its effect.

PotionOfStamina.name: potion of stamina
PotionOfStamina.desc: Drinking this oddly sweet liquid will imbue you with a long-lasting boost of energy, allowing you to run at a quickened pace for an extended period of time.

PotionOfStormClouds.name: potion of storm clouds
PotionOfStormClouds.desc: Throwing this potion will create a quickly-spreading cloud of concentrated vapor, which will condense and pour down onto the environment. Most terrain will be converted to water, fiery enemies will take damage, fire will be doused, and traps will be overwhelmed and break.

PotionOfStrength.name: potion of strength
PotionOfStrength.desc: This powerful liquid will course through your muscles, permanently increasing your strength by one point.

PotionOfToxicGas.name: potion of toxic gas
PotionOfToxicGas.desc: Uncorking or shattering this pressurized glass will cause its contents to explode into a deadly cloud of toxic green gas. You might choose to fling this potion at distant enemies instead of uncorking it by hand.

Pressurized.name: pressurized %s
Pressurized.desc: Pressurized weapons are capable of erupting with a forceful geyser of water which knocks everything away, including you.

Projecting.name: projecting %s
Projecting.desc: With this enchantment melee weapons will gain extra reach. Ranged weapons will penetrate walls when aimed at nearby targets.

Quarterstaff.name: quarterstaff
Quarterstaff.desc: A staff of hardwood, its ends are shod with iron.

Rapier.name: rapier
Rapier.desc: A slim straight sword that offers some protection in exchange for less slashing power.

RatSkull.name: rat skull
RatSkull.desc: This macabre trinket isn't much larger than the skull of a normal rat, which is somehow a rarity down in this dungeon. The skull's magical influence seems to attract the more rare denizens of the dungeon, making them appear far more often.

ReclaimTrap.name: reclaim trap
ReclaimTrap.desc:
This spell contains remnants of the mechanical energy of DM-300. When cast on an active trap, the power of the trap will become attached to you, allowing you to use the spell again to expel this power and trigger the trap's effect at any location you like.

However, some traps may not function in all places, and only one trap can be stored at a time.

Recycle.name: recycle
Recycle.desc: This spell contains a lesser form of transmutation magic. While it won't work on equipment, this spell will transform a scroll, potion, seed, runestone, or tipped dart into a random item of the same type.

RegrowthBomb.name: regrowth bomb
RegrowthBomb.desc: This customized bomb will splash life-giving liquid everywhere within 3 tiles instead of exploding. The area caught in the blast will rapidly sprout grass and plants. Yourself and any allies caught in the blast will be healed as if they had drank a potion of healing.

Repulsion.name: %s of repulsion
Repulsion.desc: This glyph rebounds force against attackers, sending them flying back.

RingOfAccuracy.name: ring of accuracy
RingOfAccuracy.desc: This ring increases your focus, making it easier for your attacks to find their mark. A cursed ring will instead make it harder for your attacks to connect.

RingOfArcana.name: ring of arcana
RingOfArcana.desc: This ring enhances magical enchantments on weapons and glyphs on armor, including curses! It first increases activation chance, and then increases the strength of the effect once activation chance is 100%. A cursed ring will instead weaken enchantments, glyphs, and curses.

RingOfElements.name: ring of elements
RingOfElements.desc: This ring provides resistance to most elemental and magical effects, decreasing damage and debuff duration. Naturally a cursed ring will instead worsen these effects.

RingOfEnergy.name: ring of energy
RingOfEnergy.desc: Your magical equipment will recharge more quickly in the arcane field that radiates from this ring. A cursed ring will instead slow recharge.

RingOfEvasion.name: ring of evasion
RingOfEvasion.desc: This ring quickens the wearer's reactions, making it harder to land blows on them. A cursed ring will instead make the user easier to strike.

RingOfForce.name: ring of force
RingOfForce.desc: This ring enhances the force of the wearer's melee blows. This extra power is fairly weak when wielding weapons, but an unarmed attack will be made much stronger. A cursed ring will instead weaken the wearer's blows.

RingOfFuror.name: ring of furor
RingOfFuror.desc: This ring grants the wearer an inner fury, allowing them to attack more rapidly. A cursed ring will instead slow the wearer's speed of attack.

RingOfHaste.name: ring of haste
RingOfHaste.desc: This ring reduces the stress of movement on the wearer, allowing them to run at superhuman speeds. A cursed ring will instead weigh the wearer down.

RingOfMight.name: ring of might
RingOfMight.desc: This ring enhances the physical traits of the wearer, granting them greater physical strength and constitution. A cursed ring will weaken the wearer.

RingOfSharpshooting.name: ring of sharpshooting
RingOfSharpshooting.desc: This ring enhances the wearer's precision and aim, which will make all projectile weapons more damaging and durable. A cursed ring will have the opposite effect.

RingOfTenacity.name: ring of tenacity
RingOfTenacity.desc: When worn, this ring will allow the wearer to resist normally mortal strikes. The more injured the user is, the more resistant they will be to damage. A cursed ring will instead make it easier for enemies to execute the wearer.

RingOfWealth.name: ring of wealth
RingOfWealth.desc: This ring acts like a magnet for treasure, increasing the likelihood that enemies and containers will be carrying valuable items. A cursed ring will instead reduce your chance of receiving loot.

RogueArmor.name: hero's garb
RogueArmor.desc: While wearing this dark garb, the Rogue can perform a special ability.

RotDart.name: rot dart
RotDart.desc: These wicked darts are tipped with an acidic rotberry-based compound, which will aggressively eat through anything the dart comes into contact with. Powerful foes will resist most of the effect, but the corrosion is strong enough to easily kill most standard enemies. These last longer than other tipped darts, but their durability cannot be boosted.

RoundShield.name: round shield
RoundShield.desc: This large shield effectively blocks attacks and makes a decent weapon in a pinch.

RunicBlade.name: runic blade
RunicBlade.desc: A mysterious weapon from a distant land, with a bright blue blade.

Sacrificial.name: sacrificial %s
Sacrificial.desc: Sacrificial weapons will demand blood from the wearer in return for attacking foes. The more healthy the wearer is, the more blood the curse will take.

Sai.name: sai
Sai.desc: Two thin blades meant to be wielded in one hand each. Excellent for tearing down enemies with a flurry of cuts.

SaltCube.name: salt cube
SaltCube.desc: This large salt crystal was cut into an almost perfect cube shape, and it somehow managed to drain half the water from the alchemy pot instead of dissolving. It seems to be magically dehydrating and preserving the food you eat, extending the satiety you get, but also lessening your health restoration when not starving.

ScaleArmor.name: scale armor
ScaleArmor.desc: The metal scales sewn onto a leather vest create a flexible, yet protective armor.

Scimitar.name: scimitar
Scimitar.desc: A thick curved blade. Its shape allows for faster, yet less powerful attacks.

ScrollHolder.name: scroll holder
ScrollHolder.desc:
This tubular container looks like it would hold an astronomer's tools and charts, but your scrolls will fit just as well. There's even a few side compartments which would nicely fit spell crystals, arcane styli, and arcane resin.

The holder doesn't look very flammable, so your scrolls should be safe from fire inside it.

ScrollOfAntiMagic.name: scroll of anti-magic
ScrollOfAntiMagic.desc: The incantation on this scroll will surround you with a magical aura that temporarily blocks all magical effects, harmful or helpful. This includes most magical item effects such as wands, scrolls, rings, artifacts, enchantments, and curses. Heroic armor abilities are strong enough to work regardless however.

ScrollOfChallenge.name: scroll of challenge
ScrollOfChallenge.desc:
When read aloud, this scroll will unleash a great roar that draws enemies to the user while simultaneously creating a small arena around them.

As long as the reader stays in this arena they will take 33% less damage from all sources (this is applied before other forms of damage reduction), and they will not lose satiety.

The size of the arena will scale with the size of the area the reader is in. It will be particularly small in some boss areas.

ScrollOfDivination.name: scroll of divination
ScrollOfDivination.desc: This scroll will randomly identify four types of item that you don't currently know. The types identified can be a potion's color, a scroll's rune, or a ring's gem. The items identified won't necessarily be ones you're carrying.

ScrollOfDread.name: scroll of dread
ScrollOfDread.desc:
When read, this scroll will emit a flash of red light that will instill incredible terror in all enemies in your field of view. So great is this effect that they will rapidly try to flee from the entire dungeon, never to be seen again!

Just like with terror, this effect can expire with time, or if the enemy is attacked.

Strong-willed enemies, such as bosses, will be inflicted with regular terror instead.

ScrollOfEnchantment.name: scroll of enchantment
ScrollOfEnchantment.desc: This scroll will infuse a weapon or armor with powerful magical energy. The reader even has some degree of control over which magic is imbued.

ScrollOfForesight.name: scroll of foresight
ScrollOfForesight.desc: After reading this scroll, the detail of nearby terrain will be constantly fed to the reader's mind in crystal clarity. This effect lasts for a considerable amount of time, and will reveal all hidden doors or traps, making searching unnecessary.

ScrollOfIdentify.name: scroll of identify
ScrollOfIdentify.desc: This scroll permanently reveals all of the secrets of a single item.

ScrollOfLullaby.name: scroll of lullaby
ScrollOfLullaby.desc: Reading this scroll emits a soothing melody which will lull all who hear it into a deep magical sleep. For the reader and their allies the sleep is restorative.

ScrollOfMagicMapping.name: scroll of magic mapping
ScrollOfMagicMapping.desc: When this scroll is read, an image of crystal clarity will be etched into your memory, alerting you to the precise layout of the level and revealing all hidden secrets. The locations of items and creatures will remain unknown.

ScrollOfMetamorphosis.name: scroll of metamorphosis
ScrollOfMetamorphosis.desc:
This scroll contains powerful transmutation magic, which will apply to the caster instead of to an item. The magic of this scroll will let you select one talent, and replace it with one of five talents of the same tier from different hero classes!

This effect can only apply to class talents, not talents gained from subclasses or armor abilities. Talents that you cannot use will not be given as options.

ScrollOfMirrorImage.name: scroll of mirror image
ScrollOfMirrorImage.desc: The incantation on this scroll will create two illusory twins of the reader. These mirror images act as weaker clones of the reader, and will chase down their enemies. They have no durability however, and will fade upon taking damage.

ScrollOfMysticalEnergy.name: scroll of mystical energy
ScrollOfMysticalEnergy.desc: The raw magical power bound up in this parchment will, when released, charge a user's equipped artifacts over time.

ScrollOfPassage.name: scroll of passage
ScrollOfPassage.desc: The spell on this parchment instantly transports the reader to the nearest region first floor above them. Very handy for quickly getting to a shop.

ScrollOfPrismaticImage.name: scroll of prismatic image
ScrollOfPrismaticImage.desc:
The incantation on this scroll will create a colorful illusory twin of the reader. This prismatic image acts as a weaker clone of the reader, with similar defence but lower hp and damage.

The prismatic image will show itself when enemies are present, and will attempt to defend the reader.

If a prismatic image already exists, using this scroll will fully heal it.

ScrollOfPsionicBlast.name: scroll of psionic blast
ScrollOfPsionicBlast.desc:
This scroll contains incredible destructive energy that can be channeled to destroy the minds of all visible creatures.

There is significant feedback however, and the reader will also be damaged, blinded, and weakened. The more targets the scroll hits, the less self-damage will be taken.

ScrollOfRage.name: scroll of rage
ScrollOfRage.desc: When read aloud, this scroll will unleash a great roar that draws all enemies to the reader, and enrages nearby ones.

ScrollOfRecharging.name: scroll of recharging
ScrollOfRecharging.desc: The raw magical power bound up in this parchment will charge up all the user's wands over time when released.

ScrollOfRemoveCurse.name: scroll of remove curse
ScrollOfRemoveCurse.desc: The incantation on this scroll will instantly strip any curses from a single weapon, ring, wand, armor, or artifact.

ScrollOfRetribution.name: scroll of retribution
ScrollOfRetribution.desc:
This scroll contains destructive energy which channels the reader's suffering outward into a blast of power. The weaker the reader is, the more damage they will deal. At very low health this scroll can kill most enemies instantly.

Using the scroll takes a toll on the user however, blinding and weakening them.

ScrollOfSirensSong.name: scroll of siren's song
ScrollOfSirensSong.desc:
Reading this scroll emits an alluring melody which will enthrall a targeted enemy, permanently turning them into an ally! Other enemies who hear it will be temporarily charmed.

Particularly strong enemies can resist the enthrall effect, and will be charmed instead.

ScrollOfTeleportation.name: scroll of teleportation
ScrollOfTeleportation.desc: The spell on this parchment instantly transports the reader to a different location on the dungeon level. The scroll prioritizes areas the reader hasn't been to before, though it is not able to teleport past locked doors or barricades. It can, however, reveal hidden doors that lead to new areas.

ScrollOfTerror.name: scroll of terror
ScrollOfTerror.desc: When read, this scroll will emit a flash of red light that will overwhelm all enemies in your field of view with terror, and they will turn and flee. Attacking a fleeing enemy will shorten the effect.

ScrollOfTransmutation.name: scroll of transmutation
ScrollOfTransmutation.desc: This scroll contains powerful transmutation magic. When used on an eligible item it will transform it into a different item of the same type. The magic will even preserve upgrades, enchantments, and glyphs. Scrolls and potions will be transmuted into their exotic equivalent, and vice-versa.

ScrollOfUpgrade.name: scroll of upgrade
ScrollOfUpgrade.desc:
This scroll will upgrade a single item or set of thrown weapons. Wands will increase in power and number of charges, weapons and armor will deal and block more damage, thrown weapon sets will be fully repaired and more durable, and the effects of rings will intensify.

It can even weaken or sometimes totally dispel curses, though it is not as potent as a scroll of remove curse. Unfortunately, the upgrading magic can also erase enchantments or glyphs on higher level gear.

SealShard.name: seal shards
SealShard.desc: These tiny shards of red wax look like they came from the seal of a fallen Warrior. You can still feel a bit of willpower clinging to the seal, you can use it to give yourself a bit of shielding. Doing this will destroy the seal shards however.

ShardOfOblivion.name: shard of oblivion
ShardOfOblivion.desc: After stewing in the alchemy pot, this small shard of cursed metal has changed to be made of... nothing? Light seems to bend around it, and it hovers in place when you aren't holding it. The shard seems to be magically drawing power from your ignorance, so it's probably best to not think about it too much.

Shocking.name: shocking %s
Shocking.desc: Electricity arcs from a shocking weapon, dealing extra damage to all nearby enemies.

ShockingBrew.name: shocking brew
ShockingBrew.desc: When shattered, this brew will unleash an electrical storm in a wide area around the location it breaks at.

ShockingDart.name: shocking dart
ShockingDart.desc: These darts are tipped with a stormvine-based compound which will deliver a nasty shock to their target.

Shortsword.name: shortsword
Shortsword.desc: A quite short sword, only a few inches longer than a dagger.

ShrapnelBomb.name: shrapnel bomb
ShrapnelBomb.desc: This bomb has been modified with scraps of DM-300's metal, which will fragment and fly everywhere when it explodes, dealing _%1$d-%2$d damage_ in a huge range around the bomb. You had better hide behind something when using it...

Shuriken.name: shuriken
Shuriken.desc: These star-shaped pieces of metal with razor-sharp blades can be quickly thrown while on the move.

Sickle.name: sickle
Sickle.desc: A handheld farming tool that can double as a strong but unwieldy weapon.

SkeletonKey.name: skeleton key
SkeletonKey.desc: An important-looking key with a head shaped like a skull. Its teeth seem to be different every time you look at them.

SmallRation.name: small food ration
SmallRation.desc: It looks exactly like a standard ration of food but smaller.

SmokeBomb.name: smoke bomb
SmokeBomb.desc: This bomb has been modified to spew a thick cloud of gas at the same time as exploding. It will deal _%1$d-%2$d damage_ and spread shrouding fog within 2 tiles.

Spear.name: spear
Spear.desc: A slender wooden rod tipped with sharpened iron.

SpiritBow.name: spirit bow
SpiritBow.desc: A bow made out of ancient magical wood. The bow's string and etchings glow with a pale blue light. When the string is pulled this bow will conjure a magical arrow which can be fired at an enemy.

Stench.name: %s of stench
Stench.desc: Armor cursed with stench will release clouds of noxious gas, which is hazardous to everything caught in the cloud.

StewedMeat.name: stewed meat
StewedMeat.desc: Stewing the meat has cleansed it of any disease or parasites. It should be safe to eat.

Stone.name: %s of stone
Stone.desc: This glyph surrounds the armor with heavy magical stone that makes dodging impossible, but blocks damage in proportion with evasion.

StoneOfAggression.name: stone of aggression
StoneOfAggression.desc:
When this stone is thrown at an ally or enemy, all nearby enemies will prefer to attack that character for a short time.

Boss enemies cannot be targeted by this effect directly, but it does work on their minions.

StoneOfAugmentation.name: stone of augmentation
StoneOfAugmentation.desc:
This runestone possesses potent magic which can augment equipment to enhance one property at the cost of another.

Using on a weapon will allow you to enhance either speed or damage. Thrown weapons will also gain or lose durability in proportion with their speed.

Using on armor will allow you to enhance either defense or evasion.

StoneOfBlast.name: stone of blast
StoneOfBlast.desc: This runestone will instantly explode at the location it is thrown to. Just like a bomb, the explosion will deal damage to anything nearby.

StoneOfBlink.name: stone of blink
StoneOfBlink.desc: This runestone will teleport the user to the location it is thrown to.

StoneOfClairvoyance.name: stone of clairvoyance
StoneOfClairvoyance.desc: This stone will instantly reveal all tiles in a very wide area around where it is thrown. Its effect will even reach through walls.

StoneOfDeepSleep.name: stone of deep sleep
StoneOfDeepSleep.desc: When this stone is thrown at an enemy, it will put them into a deep magical sleep. Magically slept enemies will sleep forever until disturbed.

StoneOfDetectMagic.name: stone of detect magic
StoneOfDetectMagic.desc: This runestone is able to detect magic affecting an item. Using this stone on an unidentified item will tell you if it is affected by a malevolent curse and whether it is affected by positive magic such as an enchantment or upgrades.

StoneOfEnchantment.name: stone of enchantment
StoneOfEnchantment.desc: This runestone possesses enchanting magic. Unlike a scroll of upgrade, it will not increase the direct power of an item, but will instead imbue a weapon or armor with an enchantment, granting it a new power.

StoneOfFear.name: stone of fear
StoneOfFear.desc: When this stone is thrown onto a character they will be overwhelmed with terror, and will turn and flee. Attacking a fleeing character will shorten the effect.

StoneOfFlock.name: stone of flock
StoneOfFlock.desc: This runestone summons magical sheep for a short time around the location it is thrown to.

StoneOfIntuition.name: stone of intuition
StoneOfIntuition.desc: This runestone holds a weaker version of the magic found in scrolls of identification. Rather than directly identifying an item, it will work on your intuition, allowing you to attempt to identify the type of a potion, scroll, or ring by guessing.

StoneOfShock.name: stone of shock
StoneOfShock.desc: This runestone unleashes a blast of electrical energy which briefly stuns all nearby targets, and grants the thrower wand charge for each target hit.

Stylus.name: arcane stylus
Stylus.desc: This arcane stylus is made of some dark, very hard stone. Using it you can inscribe a magical glyph on your armor, but you have no power over choosing what glyph it will be, the stylus will decide it for you.

SummonElemental.name: summon elemental
SummonElemental.desc: This spell channels the energy of the elemental embers used to make it, and will allow you to summon a friendly elemental to fight with you! Only one elemental can be summoned at a time, but the spell can be re-cast to return the elemental to you at no cost.

SupplyRation.name: supply ration
SupplyRation.desc:
This ration was left in the dungeon by and for members of the thieves guild. It's specifically designed to be eaten on the go, and aid with general skullduggery.

While it doesn't fill you up as much as a regular ration, it can be eaten quickly, provides a little direct healing, and will restore a charge to the Rogue's cloak of shadows.

Swiftness.name: %s of swiftness
Swiftness.desc: This glyph enhances the speed of the wearer whenever they aren't near to an enemy.

Sword.name: sword
Sword.desc: A nicely balanced sword. Not too large, but still notably longer than a shortsword.

TalismanOfForesight.name: talisman of foresight
TalismanOfForesight.desc: A smooth stone with strange engravings on it. You feel like it's watching everything around you, keeping an eye out for anything hidden.

TelekineticGrab.name: telekinetic grab
TelekineticGrab.desc:
This spell allows the caster to remotely grab all items at a location, or all thrown weapons stuck to an enemy!

It can't be used to grab items that someone else owns, or to grab containers like chests.

TengusMask.name: Tengu's mask
TengusMask.desc:
This mask fell off Tengu's face as he died, you can feel great magical power emanating from it. Was the mask Tengu's source of strength?

When worn, the tremendous power of the mask will be transferred into you, enabling you to _choose a subclass for your hero._

Which subclass will you choose?

ThirteenLeafClover.name: thirteen leaf clover
ThirteenLeafClover.desc: Somehow stewing in the alchemy pot has caused this clover to grow a bunch of extra leaves! It's not really clear if this trinket is lucky or unlucky, perhaps this trinket will make your luck more chaotic?

Thorns.name: %s of thorns
Thorns.desc: This powerful glyph harms attackers, causing them to slowly bleed when they attack the wearer.

ThrowingClub.name: throwing club
ThrowingClub.desc: A fairly simple but durable thrown weapon, essentially a large rock fastened to a stick.

ThrowingHammer.name: throwing hammer
ThrowingHammer.desc: These hefty hammers are designed to be thrown at an enemy. Their smooth all-metal construction means they are quite durable.

ThrowingKnife.name: throwing knife
ThrowingKnife.desc: These lightweight knives are balanced to arc through the air right into their target.

ThrowingSpear.name: throwing spear
ThrowingSpear.desc: These lightweight spears have thin frames which are designed to be thrown, and not thrusted.

ThrowingSpike.name: throwing spike
ThrowingSpike.desc: These durable pointed shafts of metal are meant to be thrown into distant enemies.

ThrowingStone.name: throwing stone
ThrowingStone.desc: These stones are sanded down to make them able to be thrown with more power than a regular stone.

TimekeepersHourglass.name: timekeeper's hourglass
TimekeepersHourglass.desc: This large ornate hourglass looks fairly unassuming, but you feel a great power in its finely carved frame. As you rotate the hourglass and watch the sand pour you can feel its magic tugging at you, surely using this magic would give you some control over time.

TippedDart.name: dart
TippedDart.desc: These simple shafts of spike-tipped wood are weighted to fly true and sting their prey with a flick of the wrist. They can be tipped with seeds to gain bonus effects when thrown.

Tomahawk.name: tomahawk
Tomahawk.desc: These throwing axes have a serrated edge that tears as they stick to an enemy.

Torch.name: torch
Torch.desc: An adventuring staple, when a dungeon goes dark, a torch can help lead the way.

TornPage.name: torn page
TornPage.desc: This page looks like it was ripped out of an expired Cleric's holy tome. There's still a little divine energy clinging to it, you can use it to regain a little bit of health. Doing this will destroy the torn page however.

TrapMechanism.name: trap mechanism
TrapMechanism.desc: The core mechanism of one of the dungeon's pitfall traps, carefully carved out of the floor so it can be carried. It seems to be magically tied to the dungeon itself, making hazardous terrain more common but also increasing your affinity towards it.

Trident.name: trident
Trident.desc: Massive throwing spears with three deadly prongs on the end. They are powerful, but quite heavy.

TrinketCatalyst.name: magical catalyst
TrinketCatalyst.desc:
This ball of magical golden dust glimmers in the darkness of the dungeon. This catalyst can be used at an alchemy pot with a little alchemical energy to produce a unique trinket item.

Trinkets provide various different effects that slightly alter the dungeon or its inhabitants. Trinkets can be upgraded with more energy to make their effect more powerful, or dropped to forego the effect entirely.

Unstable.name: unstable %s
Unstable.desc: This enchantment radiates chaotic energy, acting as a different enchantment with each hit.

UnstableBrew.name: unstable brew
UnstableBrew.desc:
This magical brew glows with shifting colors of the rainbow.

When drank or thrown it will trigger the effect of a random potion. The potion effect will always be beneficial if it is drank, and will always be harmful if it is thrown.

UnstableSpell.name: unstable spell
UnstableSpell.desc:
This small black square crystal has shifting runic symbols on each of its surfaces.

When activated, it will trigger the effect of a random scroll. The scroll effect will always be combat focused if there are enemies in your field of view, and will always be non-combat focused otherwise.

UnstableSpellbook.name: unstable spellbook
UnstableSpellbook.desc: This Tome is in surprising good condition given its age. It fizzes and crackles as you move the pages, surging with unstable energy. If you read from this book, there's no telling what spell you might cast.

Vampiric.name: vampiric %s
Vampiric.desc: This powerful enchantment leeches life force from enemies with each blow, funneling it back into the wearer. The effect is stronger the lower the wearer's health.

VaultBeacon.name: vault beacon
VaultBeacon.desc:
This beacon of returning spell seems to already have a location set, probably to the entry room you found it in.

You could use it to save time while exploring, or as a way to escape if you're in danger.

VelvetPouch.name: velvet pouch
VelvetPouch.desc: This small velvet pouch can store many small items in it, such as seeds, runestones, and some alchemy ingredients.

Venomous.name: venomous %s
Venomous.desc: Venomous weapons inflict a delayed but deadly poison, which becomes more severe each time it is applied.

VialOfBlood.name: vial of blood
VialOfBlood.desc: This thin vial contains the blood of some denizen of the dungeon, it moves slowly as you rotate the vial. It seems to be magically enhancing stronger healing effects, but also delaying them.

Viscosity.name: %s of viscosity
Viscosity.desc: This glyph is able to store damage dealt to the wearer, dealing it to them slowly rather than all at once.

Vorpal.name: vorpal %s
Vorpal.desc: Vorpal weapons are especially deadly, they have a chance to strike so cleanly that they inflict bleed instead of damage to enemies that can bleed.

WandOfBlastWave.name: wand of blast wave
WandOfBlastWave.desc: This wand is made of a sort of marbled stone, with gold trim and a round black gem at the tip. It feels very weighty in your hand.

WandOfCorrosion.name: wand of corrosion
WandOfCorrosion.desc: This wand has an ashen body which opens to a brilliant orange gem.

WandOfCorruption.name: wand of corruption
WandOfCorruption.desc: This wand radiates chaotic dark energy, if that weren't already obvious from the small decorative skull shaped onto its tip.

WandOfDisintegration.name: wand of disintegration
WandOfDisintegration.desc: This wand is made from a solid smooth chunk of obsidian, with a deep purple light running up its side, ending at the tip. It glows with destructive energy, waiting to shoot forward.

WandOfFireblast.name: wand of fireblast
WandOfFireblast.desc: This wand is made from red-lacquered wood with golden leaf used liberally to make it look quite regal. It crackles and hisses at the tip, eager to unleash its powerful magic.

WandOfFrost.name: wand of frost
WandOfFrost.desc: This wand seems to be made out of some kind of magical ice. It grows brighter towards its rounded tip. It feels very cold when held, but somehow your hand stays warm.

WandOfLightning.name: wand of lightning
WandOfLightning.desc: This wand is made out of solid metal, making it surprisingly heavy. Two prongs curve together at the tip, and electricity arcs between them.

WandOfLivingEarth.name: wand of living earth
WandOfLivingEarth.desc: This wand is made from a curious rock, with bands of glowing yellow energy. The rocks seem to shift slightly as you grip the wand, as if they can feel your hand.

WandOfMagicMissile.name: wand of magic missile
WandOfMagicMissile.desc: This fairly plain wand launches missiles of pure magical energy. While the wand itself lacks any special effects, it has more available charges and can briefly empower other wands when upgraded.

WandOfPrismaticLight.name: wand of prismatic light
WandOfPrismaticLight.desc: This wand is made of a solid piece of translucent crystal, like a long chunk of smooth glass. Small bits of colorful light dance around the tip of the wand, eager to burst forth.

WandOfRegrowth.name: wand of regrowth
WandOfRegrowth.desc: This wand is made from a thin shaft of expertly carved wood. Somehow it is still alive and vibrant, bright green like a young tree's core. "When life ceases new life always begins to grow... The eternal cycle always remains!"

WandOfTransfusion.name: wand of transfusion
WandOfTransfusion.desc: A fairly plainly shaped wand, it stands out due to its magenta hue and pitch black gem at the tip.

WandOfWarding.name: wand of warding
WandOfWarding.desc: This short metal wand has a bright purple gem floating above its tip.

WarHammer.name: war hammer
WarHammer.desc: Few creatures can withstand the crushing blow of this towering mass of lead and steel, but it takes great strength to use effectively.

WarScythe.name: war scythe
WarScythe.desc: This large and unwieldy tool has been reinforced to make it better at cutting foes than crops.

WarriorArmor.name: hero's plate mail
WarriorArmor.desc: While wearing this heavy plated armor, the Warrior can perform a special ability.

Waterskin.name: waterskin
Waterskin.desc: A container for liquid, made from leather and string, sealed with a cork stopper.

Wayward.name: wayward %s
Wayward.desc: Wayward weapons will sometimes become extremely inaccurate. This magic lasts for a little while when it activates, but can be dispelled by landing a blow with the wayward weapon.

Whip.name: whip
Whip.desc: While the barbed length of rope at the end of this weapon deals poor damage, its reach cannot be matched.

WildEnergy.name: wild energy
WildEnergy.desc: This spell contains some of the cursed energy which powered DM-300. When cast, it will recharge your wands and worn artifacts, while also triggering a random cursed wand effect. You are able to choose a direction for this cursed magic to shoot in, however.

Wondrous.name: wondrous %s
Wondrous.desc: Wondrous weapons contain the same chaotic magic found in cursed wands. There's no telling what will happen when this curse triggers!

WondrousResin.name: wondrous resin
WondrousResin.desc: This shimmering blue resin appears to have the distilled essence of a cursed wand's magic. The magic from the alchemy pot has seemed to stabilize it somewhat, and it's now affecting your wands.

WoollyBomb.name: woolly bomb
WoollyBomb.desc: This customized bomb will create a wide field of magical sheep after exploding. The explosion will deal _%1$d-%2$d damage_ to anything within 2 tiles. The sheep will block movement and persist for a very long time! The sheep will not last as long in the presence of powerful enemies though, and can be manually dispelled sooner by interacting with them.

WornKey.name: worn key
WornKey.desc: This key is worn and discolored, but looks serious. Probably it can open some serious door nearby.

WornShortsword.name: worn shortsword
WornShortsword.desc: A quite short sword, worn down through heavy use. It is both weaker and a bit lighter than a shortsword in better condition.

BlindweedSeed.name: seed of blindweed
BlindweedSeed.desc:
Throw this seed to the place where you want to grow a plant.

Upon being touched a blindweed perishes in a bright flash of light. The flash is strong enough to disorient for several seconds.

EarthrootSeed.name: seed of earthroot
EarthrootSeed.desc:
Throw this seed to the place where you want to grow a plant.

When a creature touches an earthroot, its roots create a kind of immobile natural armor around it.

FadeleafSeed.name: seed of fadeleaf
FadeleafSeed.desc:
Throw this seed to the place where you want to grow a plant.

Touching a fadeleaf will teleport any creature to a random place on the current level.

FirebloomSeed.name: seed of firebloom
FirebloomSeed.desc:
Throw this seed to the place where you want to grow a plant.

When something touches a firebloom, it bursts into flames.

IcecapSeed.name: seed of icecap
IcecapSeed.desc:
Throw this seed to the place where you want to grow a plant.

Upon being touched, an icecap lets out a puff of freezing pollen. The freezing effect is much stronger if the environment is wet.

MageroyalSeed.name: seed of mageroyal
MageroyalSeed.desc:
Throw this seed to the place where you want to grow a plant.

The mageroyal's prickly flowers contain a chemical which is known for its properties as a strong neutralizing agent. Anything that steps in this plant will be cleansed of many negative effects.

RotberrySeed.name: seed of rotberry
RotberrySeed.desc:
Throw this seed to the place where you want to grow a plant.

The berries of a young rotberry shrub taste like sweet, sweet death. Over a few years, this rotberry shrub will grow into another rot heart. When trampled, a young rotberry will produce a small puff of toxic gas.

SorrowmossSeed.name: seed of sorrowmoss
SorrowmossSeed.desc:
Throw this seed to the place where you want to grow a plant.

A sorrowmoss is a flower (not a moss) with razor-sharp petals, coated with a deadly venom.

StarflowerSeed.name: seed of starflower
StarflowerSeed.desc:
Throw this seed to the place where you want to grow a plant.

A rare plant, starflower is said to grant holy power to whomever touches it.

StormvineSeed.name: seed of stormvine
StormvineSeed.desc:
Throw this seed to the place where you want to grow a plant.

Gravity affects the stormvine plant strangely, allowing its whispy blue tendrils to 'hang' on the air. Anything caught in the vine is affected by this, and becomes disoriented.

SungrassSeed.name: seed of sungrass
SungrassSeed.desc:
Throw this seed to the place where you want to grow a plant.

Sungrass is renowned for its sap's slow but effective healing properties.

SwiftthistleSeed.name: seed of swiftthistle
SwiftthistleSeed.desc:
Throw this seed to the place where you want to grow a plant.

When trampled, swiftthistle will briefly accelerate the flow of time around it, allowing the trampler to perform several actions instantly.

BlandfruitBushSeed.name: seed of blandfruit
BlandfruitBushSeed.desc:
Throw this seed to the place where you want to grow a plant.

Distant cousin of the rotberry, the pear-shaped produce of the blandfruit bush tastes like caked dust. The fruit is gross and unsubstantial but isn't poisonous. Perhaps it could be cooked.

DewcatcherSeed.name: seed of Dewcatcher
DewcatcherSeed.desc:
Throw this seed to the place where you want to grow a plant.

Dewcatchers are wondrous plants that fill themselves with magical dew. They attempt to camouflage as grass to avoid attention, but their bulges of collected dew give them away.

SeedpodSeed.name: seed of Seed Pod
SeedpodSeed.desc:
Throw this seed to the place where you want to grow a plant.

Seed Pods are magical plants that produce seeds from other plant types, rather than any seeds of their own. They somehow manage to spread despite having no seed of their own.

SandalsOfNature.name: sandals of nature
SandalsOfNature.desc: What initially seem like sandals made of twine are actually two plants! They seem very weak and pale, perhaps they need to be given nutrients?

DoubleBomb.name: two bombs
DoubleBomb.desc: A stack of two hefty black powder bombs, looks like you get one free!

ShatteredPot.name: shattered honeypot
ShatteredPot.desc:
The pot has been shattered, only the sticky honey that lines its walls is holding it together, and it is slowly coming apart.

Despite its broken state, the bee still seems to want to protect the pot.

SandBag.name: bag of magic sand
SandBag.desc:
This small bag of fine sand should work perfectly with your hourglass.

It seems odd that the shopkeeper would have this specific item right when you need it...
